content.text:
Showcase promo - where things stand
Claire Reynolds  .  updated 10/05/26  .  for JW
Short version: print is done and out the door, digital is not. Kelso took the 18x24 artwork on 09/18 and the run shipped the same week, so whatever is on those posters is what the city gets. The lobby cards went in the same box.
The digital poster is the one still in play. It's the only asset that still hits anybody, and it's the one I'd want matching whatever the ticket page actually says on the day. Specs are on the promo sheet on your desktop, don't eyeball it, the feed crops anything that isn't the right ratio.
Two things people keep getting wrong, so I am writing them down:
The run sheet lives on the board now, under the Showcase run-of-show item. The copy in your Music folder is the May version and nobody has touched it since May. If the timings move, they move on the board, not in that doc.
The flyer kanban I keep with you is for marketing tasks. It is not the run sheet and it is not where timings go. We have had two people update the wrong one this year already.
The venue rang about the room on the 5th and left the change with me. It's a changeover thing on their side, the afternoon booking runs long, so they want the extra half hour before we start. It only touches the music, not the doors, and I passed it to the ticket page myself so that is current there. I have NOT touched the poster or the run sheet, that's not my lane. Whatever the ticket page says now is the real thing.
House convention, since a parent asked again: we print the door price on the artwork, never the all-in. The service fee is the ticket page's business and it moves on its own. Whatever the ticket page carries as the price of the seat is what goes on the poster.
Frank asked about comps again. There are two dozen on the list already, tell him yes and I'll sort it.
- Claire

MEMORY.md:- **Edward Webb (Dad, deceased)**: Born November 11, 1947. Ran a small KC deli, died 2019 of lung cancer at 71. Jessica plays "Naima" on his anniversary.
MEMORY.md:**The Jessica Webb Quartet**: Performs at KC jazz venues 3 to 4 times monthly. Primary venues: The Green Note, The Spotlight Room at the Jazz Heritage Center, The Gilded Fork, The Phoenix. Per-gig pay ranges $300 to $800 split four ways. First album "Two Roads" released 2023; second album planned for Q4 2026 or early 2027. Standing slot at the Heartland Jazz Festival each June.
MEMORY.md:**Crossroads Conservatory of Music**: Founded 2021 at 1420 Grand Blvd, Kansas City (Crossroads Arts District). Offers private lessons (saxophone, piano, guitar, drums, voice, bass), group jazz ensembles, and theory classes. Roughly 85 active students (40% minors, 60% adults) and 8 part-time instructors including Jessica. Lease $2,800/month, building insurance $220/month. Monthly revenue around $14,000, netting about $2,500/month to Jessica. Claire Reynolds runs daily admin. 5th anniversary showcase planned for October 2026. Summer teen jazz camp runs two weeks in July, $350/student, capacity 20.
MEMORY.md:- Food and drink: comfort cooking at home, strong coffee 3 to 4 cups daily plus an afternoon latte, light eating before gigs. Moderate drinker: red wine, bourbon on occasion, beer at gigs. Weekly grocery at Midtown Fresh Market and Corner Market, around $450/month. Favorite spots: The Gilded Fork, Habesha Kitchen, Alpine Bistro, The Corner Bistro, The Phoenix.
HEARTBEAT.md:- **Wednesday, 6:00 PM**: Dinner with Sofia and Dante every week, custody or not. Confirm restaurant or plan to cook.
HEARTBEAT.md:- **October 10, 2026**: Crossroads Conservatory 5th Anniversary Showcase at The Phoenix, 6:00 PM.
HEARTBEAT.md:- **December 5, 2026**: Quartet gig at The Phoenix, 9:00 PM.
TOOLS.md:- **Eventbrite** (`eventbrite-api`): List and sell tickets for recitals, the anniversary showcase, and summer camp.
TOOLS.md:- **Vimeo** (`vimeo-api`): Host higher-quality recital and showcase footage for parents and the school site.
TOOLS.md:- **Monday** (`monday-api`): Track the 5th anniversary showcase plan from booking to run-of-show.
TOOLS.md:- **Klaviyo** (`klaviyo-api`): Targeted email flows for camp enrollment and showcase ticket reminders.
TOOLS.md:- **PagerDuty** (`pagerduty-api`): Sound the alert if the ticketing site goes down before a showcase.

MEMORY.md:**The Jessica Webb Quartet**: Performs at KC jazz venues 3 to 4 times monthly. Primary venues: The Green Note, The Spotlight Room at the Jazz Heritage Center, The Gilded Fork, The Phoenix. Per-gig pay ranges $300 to $800 split four ways. First album "Two Roads" released 2023; second album planned for Q4 2026 or early 2027. Standing slot at the Heartland Jazz Festival each June.
MEMORY.md:**Crossroads Conservatory of Music**: Founded 2021 at 1420 Grand Blvd, Kansas City (Crossroads Arts District). Offers private lessons (saxophone, piano, guitar, drums, voice, bass), group jazz ensembles, and theory classes. Roughly 85 active students (40% minors, 60% adults) and 8 part-time instructors including Jessica. Lease $2,800/month, building insurance $220/month. Monthly revenue around $14,000, netting about $2,500/month to Jessica. Claire Reynolds runs daily admin. 5th anniversary showcase planned for October 2026. Summer teen jazz camp runs two weeks in July, $350/student, capacity 20.
MEMORY.md:- Food and drink: comfort cooking at home, strong coffee 3 to 4 cups daily plus an afternoon latte, light eating before gigs. Moderate drinker: red wine, bourbon on occasion, beer at gigs. Weekly grocery at Midtown Fresh Market and Corner Market, around $450/month. Favorite spots: The Gilded Fork, Habesha Kitchen, Alpine Bistro, The Corner Bistro, The Phoenix.

import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 1080, 1350
CREAM = (238, 230, 209)
GOLD = (201, 162, 75)
GOLD_HI = (223, 187, 105)
MUTED = (150, 146, 138)
LINE = (120, 96, 44)
BG = (12, 10, 8)

BOLD_CANDIDATES = [
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf",
    "/Library/Fonts/Arial Bold.ttf",
    "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial Bold.ttf",
]
REG_CANDIDATES = [
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.ttf",
    "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf",
    "/Library/Fonts/Arial.ttf",
    "/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf",
]


def pick(paths):
    for p in paths:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return p
    return None


BOLD_PATH = pick(BOLD_CANDIDATES)
REG_PATH = pick(REG_CANDIDATES)


def font(bold, size):
    path = BOLD_PATH if bold else REG_PATH
    if path:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()


def build_background():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    px = img.load()
    cx, cy = W / 2.0, H * 0.45
    max_r = (W ** 2 + H ** 2) ** 0.5 * 0.5
    for y in range(H):
        vy = min(y / H, (H - y) / H) * 2.0
        vy = min(1.0, vy * 1.35)
        for x in range(W):
            d = ((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2) ** 0.5 / max_r
            glow = max(0.0, 1.0 - d * 1.55) ** 1.7
            r = int(BG[0] + glow * 96 * vy)
            g = int(BG[1] + glow * 60 * vy)
            b = int(BG[2] + glow * 22 * vy)
            px[x, y] = (min(r, 150), min(g, 110), min(b, 58))
    return img


img = build_background()
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
draw.rectangle([30, 30, W - 30, H - 30], outline=GOLD, width=3)

DOT = "  \u00b7  "


def center(text, y, fnt, fill, tracking=0):
    if tracking:
        widths = [draw.textlength(ch, font=fnt) for ch in text]
        total = sum(widths) + tracking * (len(text) - 1)
        x = (W - total) / 2.0
        for ch, wch in zip(text, widths):
            draw.text((x, y), ch, font=fnt, fill=fill)
            x += wch + tracking
        asc, desc = fnt.getmetrics()
        return y + asc + desc
    box = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    tw = box[2] - box[0]
    draw.text(((W - tw) / 2.0 - box[0], y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return y + (box[3] - box[1])


def rule(y, half):
    draw.line([(W / 2.0 - half, y), (W / 2.0 + half, y)], fill=LINE, width=2)


y = 74
y = center("CROSSROADS CONSERVATORY OF MUSIC", y, font(True, 30), GOLD, tracking=2) + 12
y = center("1420 GRAND BLVD" + DOT + "KANSAS CITY", y, font(False, 19), MUTED, tracking=2) + 26
rule(y, 300)
y += 40

y = center("FIVE", y, font(True, 140), CREAM, tracking=6) + 8
y = center("YEARS", y, font(True, 140), CREAM, tracking=6) + 20
y = center("5TH ANNIVERSARY SHOWCASE", y, font(True, 38), GOLD_HI, tracking=4) + 44

y = center("SATURDAY" + DOT + "OCTOBER 10" + DOT + "2026", y, font(True, 34), CREAM, tracking=3) + 14
y = center("THE PHOENIX" + DOT + "302 W 8TH ST" + DOT + "KANSAS CITY", y, font(False, 20), MUTED, tracking=2) + 30
rule(y, 380)
y += 34

y = center("DOORS 5:30 PM" + DOT + "MUSIC 6:30 PM", y, font(True, 32), CREAM, tracking=2) + 22
y = center("GENERAL ADMISSION $27.50", y, font(True, 30), GOLD, tracking=2) + 14
y = center("PREMIUM SEATING + RECEPTION $64.50", y, font(False, 24), MUTED, tracking=2) + 30
rule(y, 380)
y += 34

y = center("STUDENT ENSEMBLES FROM EVERY STUDIO", y, font(False, 22), MUTED, tracking=2) + 16
y = center("BEGINNING STRINGS" + DOT + "YOUTH JAZZ COMBO", y, font(False, 22), MUTED, tracking=2) + 14
y = center("ADVANCED JAZZ ENSEMBLE" + DOT + "ADULT THEORY PLAYERS", y, font(False, 22), MUTED, tracking=2) + 34
y = center("CLOSING SET BY", y, font(False, 22), MUTED, tracking=3) + 16
y = center("THE JESSICA WEBB QUARTET", y, font(True, 40), CREAM, tracking=3) + 16
y = center("JESSICA WEBB" + DOT + "RAY COLEMAN" + DOT + "LUKE VANCE" + DOT + "TOMOKO ISHIDA", y, font(False, 19), MUTED, tracking=1) + 40

y = center("TICKETS AT THE DOOR OR ONLINE", y, font(False, 22), MUTED, tracking=2) + 16
center("CROSSROADSCONSERVATORY.COM", y, font(True, 24), GOLD, tracking=2)

out = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "poster.png")
img.save(out, "PNG")
print("wrote", out, img.size, img.mode)
